title: Assign a Quiz to Your Class
description: Live tour: choose a quiz, target a class, review assignment options, and assign it in SpartBoard.

steps.label: Assign quiz
steps.text: Click **Assign** on the first quiz you want to send to students.

steps.label: SpartBoard Only
steps.text: Click **SpartBoard Only** to create a join link for your classes.

steps.label: Assignment options
steps.text: Choose the class taking this quiz, then review the assessment, availability, due date, and student modification settings.

steps.label: Assign
steps.text: Click **Assign** to publish the quiz and create its student join link.

welcomeMessage: Assign a quiz to one of your classes in SpartBoard.
